name: Pendlay Row
summary: A strict barbell row where the bar returns to the floor after every rep and the torso stays parallel to the ground, emphasizing explosive pulling from a dead stop.
setup: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and hinge until the torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with an overhand grip.
Set a flat back, tight lats and braced abs with the bar resting on the floor.
execution: Pull the bar explosively to the lower chest or upper stomach.
Keep the torso parallel to the floor, with no hip or chest lift.
Lower the bar under control back to the floor and reset.
mistakes: Raising the torso to heave the weight: lighten the load and keep the angle.
Losing the flat back at the floor: reset and brace before every pull.
Bouncing the bar off the floor: pause briefly and re-set tension.
Using an underhand grip with heavy weight: use an overhand grip.

references.title: How To Build a Thick Back With Perfect Rowing Technique (Pendlay Row/ Helms Row)
references.author: Jeff Nippard
